description: 2025 pregame-safe held-out forward validation of *four-unit component* under three settings; NOT a validation of the full 25/35/25/15 BetWise ranking.
evaluation: Week >=3; ratings frozen after previous week; raw observed game unit statistics normalized only on games from preceding weeks; excludes FCS games.
limitations: Shared forward games and overlapping weekly training samples mean tiny differences require additional season-level uncertainty evaluation.
Market, ATS and quality-of-competition components are not pregame reconstructed; comparison is for units only, not overall dominance.
Past FBS games with missing advanced stats excluded; verify coverage and provider filtering.
2025 data was used to choose candidate curves, so confirmation on an untouched season is necessary before claiming superiority.
